extension.summary: Aeon Fuse - the look of Aeon 2 with ideas from Arctic Fuse, built on the Glass skin.
extension.description: Aeon Fuse brings the look of Aeon 2 to Kodi with ideas from Arctic Fuse. Three themes (Aeon, Aeon Glass, Fused Glass), four menu styles, library views for films, shows and music with watched marks, media chips and time left, a Planner of new episodes, and its own screensaver and waveform visualizer. Built on the Glass skin; the Aeon Fuse Helper add-on does the work Kodi cannot.

v0.37.0 - Landing animation setting (Pop, Grow, Fade, Glow, Nudge, Lift, None) and five font combinations with a live preview. - Video OSD: times clear of the seek marker, calmer top bar, Up next in the card, left block centred.
